sources.storage_policy: Store raw responses as content-addressed snapshots outside the repository.
sources.redistribution_policy: Redistribution is permitted under CC0; retain source attribution in manifests.
sources.freshness_policy: Fetch on demand; use entity revision IDs and create a new run to refresh.
sources.identifier_rules: Wikidata QID is exact source identity. P1278 is a LEI crosswalk candidate and is bound only after checksum and ownership checks.
sources.mapping_rules: Map allowlisted P31 classes to core entity types. Labels and aliases generate lookup candidates only.
data_quality_checks: QID must match Q followed by digits.
Entity must have a non-empty English or Vietnamese label.
Unknown P31 classes are skipped rather than guessed.
LEI crosswalks must pass ISO 17442 check-digit validation.

sources.record_schema: GLEIF API v1 JSON:API LEI record; schema 1
sources.storage_policy: Store raw responses as content-addressed snapshots outside the repository.
sources.redistribution_policy: Redistribution is permitted under CC0; do not imply GLEIF endorsement.
sources.freshness_policy: The API reports Golden Copy publication time; fetch on demand and refresh in a new run.
sources.identifier_rules: A valid LEI is the exact authoritative identifier namespace gleif-lei; names are candidate labels only.
sources.mapping_rules: Map legal name and other names to an Organization record; do not infer ownership from names.
data_quality_checks: Response LEI must match the requested LEI and pass ISO 17442 check-digit validation.
Entity status must be present and retained without filtering historical status semantics.

sources.record_schema: MediaWiki Action API extracts and revisions JSON; schema 1
sources.storage_policy: Store raw responses and extracted text as content-addressed snapshots outside the repository.
sources.redistribution_policy: When redistributing derived content, preserve attribution and applicable share-alike terms.
sources.freshness_policy: Use the latest returned revision; record page ID, revision ID and revision timestamp.
sources.identifier_rules: Page ID plus revision ID identifies a document version; title matching never establishes entity identity.
sources.mapping_rules: Extract only explicit subsidiary-of statements into organization:subsidiaryOf; resolve the page subject by its Wikidata pageprops QID and the object through a unique exact alias. Use revision time as the earliest supported valid time for present-tense statements.
data_quality_checks: Page ID, revision ID, timestamp, title and non-empty text are required.
Assertion evidence span must equal the exact substring in the archived document text.
Unresolved or ambiguous subjects and objects are routed to review by the canonical pipeline.
